wake.speaker: tomas
wake.text: Mother Serene says if you're still in bed when the last bell rings, you're helping me clean the courtyard.

wake.speaker: tomas
wake.text: No. But she might, once I suggest it.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Enjoy a quiet breakfast while you can. Tomorrow we’ll have everyone coming and going for the Festival of Light.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Today we make sure everything—and everyone—is ready for it.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: That sounds like rather more work.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: *with a small smile* It usually is.

books.label: bookshelf
books.text: Two chapters left. I keep telling myself I'll finish them before festival week.

notes.label: desk notes
notes.text: Copies of the old local inscriptions. Serene says they're easier to read once I stop adding my own guesses.

drawing.label: family drawing
drawing.text: Tomas insisted that's me. I'm still not sure why he gave me such enormous ears.

window.label: window
window.text: Eldenmere's already awake. It smells like somebody started baking before sunrise.

acceptance.speaker: serene
acceptance.text: Thank you. Halden first, then visit the other two in whichever order suits you.

acceptance.speaker: tomas
acceptance.text: Shall I come for all three?

acceptance.speaker: serene
acceptance.text: Come back after Halden. I’ll need your help with the sanctuary preparations.

acceptance.speaker: tomas
acceptance.text: I was hoping for something interesting.

acceptance.speaker: serene
acceptance.text: Then start by helping someone who needs you.

acceptance.speaker: caelan
acceptance.text: *to Tomas* Come on. You can decide how interesting it was afterward.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: tomas
breakfast_greeting.text: There you are. I saved you some bread.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: tomas
breakfast_greeting.text: *grins* Mother Serene wouldn’t let me eat it.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: serene
breakfast_greeting.text: Sit down, Caelan. Before your brother decides you aren’t coming.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: serene
breakfast_greeting.text: Long enough to wish there were another pair of hands in the kitchen.

kindness.speaker: serene
kindness.text: Thank you, Caelan. Now, could you both spare me a little time?
